exercises.instructionEn: Moments in Life — Read, listen, talk and write about...
exercises.instructionUz: Hayotdagi lahzalar — o'qing, tinglang, gapiring va yozing...
exercises.explanationUz:
3-MODUL SARLAVHASI: 'Moments in Life'
  = Hayotdagi lahzalar

Muqovada modulning IKKI BIRINCHI uniti ko'rsatilgan.

UNIT 9 — 'Times Change...'
  = Zamon o'zgaradi...
  MAVZU: joylar va binolar (places & buildings)
  RASMLAR: zamonaviy aeroport va samolyot;
           eski baliqchi qayig'i va tinch qirg'oq
  Ikki rasm o'tmish va hozirni qiyoslaydi —
  unit shu haqda bo'ladi.

UNIT 10 — 'The Price of Fame!'
  = Shuhratning bahosi!
  MAVZU: mashhur odamlar va ularning yutuqlari
         (famous people & their achievements)
  RASMLAR: shahzoda Diana va Elvis Presli —
           ikkalasi ham juda mashhur bo'lgan,
           lekin hayoti fojiali tugagan odamlar.

SARLAVHALAR MA'NOSI:
  'Times change' — maqol: zamon o'zgaradi, hayot o'zgaradi.
  'The price of fame' — shuhrat uchun to'lanadigan baho
     (mashhurlik faqat foyda emas, qiyinchilik ham keltiradi).

tasks.en: Moments in Life — Read, listen, talk and write about...
tasks.uz: Hayotdagi lahzalar — o'qing, tinglang, gapiring va yozing...

tasks.note:
3-modulning umumiy sarlavhasi.
'a moment' = lahza, on.

tasks.en: Read, listen, talk and write about...
tasks.uz: Quyidagilar haqida o'qing, tinglang, gapiring va yozing...
tasks.note: To'rt ko'nikma: reading, listening, speaking, writing.

'Times change' — o'zgarishlar haqidagi maqol.
'time' bu yerda KO'PLIKDA — 'zamonlar, davrlar'.
Shahar, qishloq, uy, do'kon, bino turlari.

'fame' = shuhrat, mashhurlik.
'a price' = baho, narx.

tasks.en: Unit 10 topic: famous people & their achievements
tasks.uz: 10-unit mavzusi: mashhur odamlar va ularning yutuqlari
tasks.note:
'an achievement' = yutuq, muvaffaqiyat.
'to achieve' = erishmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
MODUL 3 — 9 dan 12 gacha bo'lgan unitlar.

UNIT 11 — 'All's Well That Ends Well!'
  = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi!
  Bu — Shekspir pyesasining nomi va ingliz maqoli.
  O'zbekcha muqobili: 'Oxiri xayr bo'lsin.'
  MAVZU: his-tuyg'ular va munosabatlar (feelings & reactions),
         favqulodda holatlar (emergencies)
  RASMLAR: mashinaga hujum qilayotgan sherlar (xavf);
           qo'rqqan va xursand odamlar (his-tuyg'ular)

UNIT 12 — 'See New Places, Meet New Faces!'
  = Yangi joylarni ko'ring, yangi odamlar bilan tanishing!
  MAVZU: shaharlar (towns & cities),
         transport turlari (means of transport)
  RASMLAR: zamonaviy katta shahar; eski somon tomli uy

tasks.note: Har bir modul 4 unitdan iborat.

tasks.en: Unit 11 — All's Well That Ends Well!
tasks.note:
Shekspir pyesasining nomi va ingliz maqoli.
'All's' = All IS.

tasks.uz: 11-unit mavzulari: his-tuyg'ular va munosabatlar, favqulodda holatlar

tasks.en: Unit 12 — See New Places, Meet New Faces!
tasks.uz: 12-unit — Yangi joylarni ko'ring, yangi odamlar bilan tanishing!
tasks.note:
'places' va 'faces' — QOFIYA (reklama uslubi).
'a face' bu yerda = odam.

tasks.en: Unit 12 topics: towns & cities, means of transport

exercises.instructionUz: O'rganish maqsadlari va mashq qilinadigan grammatika.
exercises.explanationUz:
LEARN HOW TO ... (nima qilishni o'rganasiz):
  • give directions ........... yo'l ko'rsatmoq
  • ask for information ....... ma'lumot so'ramoq
  • ask personal questions .... shaxsiy savol bermoq
  • report emergencies ........ favqulodda holat haqida xabar bermoq
  • make comments ............. fikr bildirmoq
  • make suggestions .......... taklif kiritmoq

PRACTISE ... (qaysi grammatikani mashq qilasiz):
  • was/were – had – could
       O'TGAN ZAMON boshlanadi!
       was/were — 'be' ning o'tgan zamoni
       had — 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni
       could — 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni
  • past simple (regular – irregular verbs)
       o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar
  • prepositions of place/movement
       joy va harakat predloglari
  • adjectives/adverbs
       sifat va ravish
  • comparisons
       qiyoslash (bigger, the biggest)
  • quite/too/very/much
       daraja so'zlari

DIQQAT — MUHIM O'ZGARISH:
  1-8 unitlarda faqat HOZIRGI zamon o'rganilgan edi
  (Present Simple va Present Continuous).
  3-moduldan boshlab O'TGAN ZAMON kiritiladi.
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, modul muqovasi (o'ng bet) — Learn how to / Practise

tasks.uz: O'rganish maqsadlari va mashq qilinadigan grammatika.

tasks.note:
'directions' = yo'l ko'rsatmalari.
'Turn left', 'Go straight on' kabi iboralar.

tasks.en: Learn how to ask for information
tasks.note: 'ask FOR something' — 'for' shart.

tasks.en: Learn how to ask personal questions
tasks.note: Yosh, kasb, oila haqidagi savollar.

tasks.uz: Favqulodda holat haqida xabar berishni o'rganing
tasks.note:
'to report' = xabar bermoq.
Yong'in, baxtsiz hodisa, kasallik.

'a comment' = fikr, izoh.
'make a comment' = fikr bildirmoq.

'a suggestion' = taklif.
'Let's ...', 'Why don't we ...?' kabi iboralar.

tasks.uz: was/were – had – could ni mashq qiling
tasks.note:
O'TGAN ZAMON shakllari:
  am/is → WAS;  are → WERE
  have/has → HAD
  can → COULD

tasks.uz: O'tgan zamonni mashq qiling (to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar)
tasks.note:
TO'G'RI fe'l: work → workED
NOTO'G'RI fe'l: go → WENT, see → SAW

tasks.uz: Joy va harakat predloglarini mashq qiling
tasks.note:
JOY: in, on, under, next to
HARAKAT: into, out of, along, across, through

SIFAT otni tavsiflaydi: a QUICK car
RAVISH fe'lni tavsiflaydi: drive QUICKLY

big → biggER → the biggEST
good → better → the best

quite = ancha;  very = juda;
too = haddan tashqari;  much = ancha (qiyosda)

wordFormation.explanationUz: Fe'lga -ment qo'shilib natijani bildiruvchi ot yasaladi.
'make' ko'p otlar bilan turg'un birikma yasaydi.
